author: Mark Atwood
text:
Releasing stale bd-spin claim from prior session. Server half (`verify_tls_server`) shipped; client half scope clarified by closed child PKIX-fmtv.11.2.1.

**Client-half scope (per PKIX-fmtv.11.2.1's decision comment, Mark, 2026-05-12):**

Ship two functions, matching the verify_tls_server shape:

```rust
pub fn verify_tls_client_dns<P, R>(
    chain: &[Certificate],
    anchors: &[TrustAnchor],
    name: Option<&ServerName<'_>>,   // None = chain-only, no identity binding
    profile: &P,
    now_unix: u64,
    revocation: &R,
) -> crate::Result<ValidatedPath>
where P: Profile, R: RevocationChecker;

pub fn verify_tls_client_mailbox<P, R>(
    chain: &[Certificate],
    anchors: &[TrustAnchor],
    mailbox: Option<&MailboxName<'_>>,
    profile: &P,
    now_unix: u64,
    revocation: &R,
) -> crate::Result<ValidatedPath>
where P: Profile, R: RevocationChecker;
```

Both bodies: `verify_chain(...)` then `pkix_identity::verify_dns_name(&chain[0], name)?` or `pkix_identity::verify_mailbox(&chain[0], mailbox)?` if identity is `Some`.

Order-of-checks matches verify_tls_server: path validation FIRST, identity binding SECOND. Existing `Error::Identity(IdentityError)` variant reused.

**Fixtures to add:**
- `leaf-tls-client-dns.der` — dNSName SAN, id-kp-clientAuth EKU
- `leaf-tls-client-mailbox.der` — rfc822Name SAN, id-kp-clientAuth EKU
(both signed by the existing test root)

**Tests per function (mirror verify_tls_server):**
- Positive: matching identity + valid chain → Ok
- Identity mismatch → Error::Identity
- Missing relevant SAN → Error::Identity
- Identity == None → Ok (chain-only)
- Order-of-checks: invalid chain + matching identity → path error, not identity error
- BasicTlsProfile smoke test wires generic correctly

Re-export `MailboxName` in pkix-chain if not already (it is — checked).
